Pakistan ke mohammad zishan ali chin ke shenjhou-24 mishan ke tahat antriksh men jane vale pahle pakistani antriksh yatri banne ja rahe hain. vah chin ke tiyangong spes steshan par pelod eksapart ke taur par vaigyanik prayogon men hissa lenge. unki trening kaisi rahi? antriksh men pakistan ke kaun se prayog honge aur is mishan se chin-pakistan ki antriksh sajhedari ko kaise naee disha milegi?
